name: Submagic
summary: Editor for short-form video that adds AI captions, B-roll, zooms and other edits automatically.
description: Submagic edits short-form videos for social media. It generates animated captions, adds B-roll, sound effects and transitions, removes silences, trims clips, corrects eye contact and translates videos. A publishing tool and an API support automation. Plans start at $19 per month for 15 videos up to two minutes, with Pro at $39 and Business at $69 per month. A free trial is offered; a permanent free plan was not confirmed.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: The official pricing page lists Starter at $19/month and Pro at $39/month. A Try For Free button is shown, but no lasting $0 plan was listed.
